input: Schedule a professional carpet cleaning for the stairs

gold.taskTitle: Schedule Professional Carpet Cleaning for the Stairs
gold.taskDescription: Book a professional carpet cleaning service specifically for the stairs in the user's home.

questions.title: How many stairs or flights need cleaning?
questions.description: Understand the scope and size of the staircase to be cleaned.

questions.title: Do you already have a preferred cleaning company?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a service provider in mind or needs help finding one.

questions.title: What is your target date for the cleaning?
questions.description: Identify the desired date or timeframe so scheduling can be planned accordingly.

questions.title: What type of carpet material is on the stairs?
questions.description: Know the carpet fiber or material so the right cleaning method can be requested.

questions.title: Are there specific stains or damage to address?
questions.description: Understand if there are problem areas that require special treatment beyond a standard clean.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for this service?
questions.description: Establish a budget range to help filter and select an appropriate cleaning provider.

questions.title: Is anyone home during the day to let them in?
questions.description: Clarify access and availability so the appointment can be scheduled at a workable time.
